title: Sharks Can Sense Electricity Five Billionths of a Volt Strong

scenes.text: Sharks can sense electricity five billionths of a volt strong.
Their snouts are covered in jelly-filled pores called ampullae of Lorenzini.
The smooth dogfish can detect five billionths of a volt per centimeter.
That's the faint field every living animal gives off.
It lets hammerheads find stingrays buried in the sand.
One source compares it to a flashlight battery with its ends 10,000 miles apart.
Five billionths of a volt. That's all it needs.

description:
